Special-Issue Monitor

Separate pipelines: CFP access limits do not reduce article coverage. Articles are collected independently by ISSN for all 70 journals.

Automated CFP monitoring now covers all configured Taylor & Francis and SAGE journals, plus the Cogitatio and Wiley titles. OUP and IJoC use dated official-source records; Elsevier and Hogrefe remain qualified gaps.
